units.text: Well, little girl, here I am, still alive! Still alive! In the High School, together with little Olga, in her official apartments... so the Lord has appointed for my old age. Sinful woman that I am, I’ve never lived like that in my life before.... A large flat, government property, and I’ve a whole room and bed to myself. All government property. I wake up at nights and, oh God, and Holy Mother, there isn’t a happier person than I!
units.name: ANFISA

units.text: We are going soon, Olga Sergeyevna. It’s time for me to go.
units.name: VERSHININ

units.text: I wish you every... every.... Where’s Maria Sergeyevna?
units.name: VERSHININ

units.text: She’s somewhere in the garden. I’ll go and look for her.
units.name: IRINA

units.text: If you’ll be so kind. I haven’t time.
units.name: VERSHININ

units.text: Goes out with IRINA down into the garden.
Everything comes to an end. And so we, too, must part.
units.name: VERSHININ

units.text: The town gave us a sort of farewell breakfast, we had champagne to drink and the mayor made a speech, and I ate and listened, but my soul was here all the time....
units.name: VERSHININ

units.text: I’m so used to you now.
units.name: VERSHININ

units.text: My wife and both my daughters will stay here another two months. If anything happens, or if anything has to be done...
units.name: VERSHININ

units.text: Yes, yes, of course. You need not worry.
units.name: OLGA

units.text: To-morrow there won’t be a single soldier left in the town, it will all be a memory, and, of course, for us a new life will begin....
units.name: OLGA

units.text: None of our plans are coming right. I didn’t want to be a head-mistress, but they made me one, all the same. It means there’s no chance of Moscow....
units.name: OLGA

units.text: Well... thank you for everything. Forgive me if I’ve... I’ve said such an awful lot--forgive me for that too, don’t think badly of me.
units.name: VERSHININ

units.text: What else can I say in parting? Can I philosophize about anything?
units.name: VERSHININ

units.text: Life is heavy. To many of us it seems dull and hopeless, but still, it must be acknowledged that it is getting lighter and clearer, and it seems that the time is not far off when it will be quite clear.
units.name: VERSHININ

units.text: It’s time I went! Mankind used to be absorbed in wars, and all its existence was filled with campaigns, attacks, defeats, now we’ve outlived all that, leaving after us a great waste place, which there is nothing to fill with at present; but mankind is looking for something, and will certainly find it. Oh, if it only happened more quickly.
units.name: VERSHININ

units.text: If only education could be added to industry, and industry to education.
units.name: VERSHININ

units.text: OLGA steps aside a little, so as not to be in their way.
